source.note: Plan row 196 (Quaternius static Sword via poly.pizza) is blocked, so this is Sword.fbx from Quaternius's own CC0 Medieval Weapons Pack on OpenGameArt (same author, licence on the page). KayKit Adventures sword_1handed.gltf (CC0, commit 672074b) was rendered too and not taken: its atlas splits into 11 near-identical greys scattered across blade and guard faces, so blade and guard cannot be told apart, and the blade is a stubby chibi wedge. Height 0.9 m is the whole sword, pommel to tip (an arming sword). Rest pose: upright, tip at +Y, pommel on y = 0; blade flat in the XY plane (edges along X, crossguard about 0.19 m wide along X, 4 cm thick along Z). Grip from y 0.04 to 0.22 m (hold at about y 0.13 m; the model origin is the pommel's bottom centre, on the blade axis), pommel 0 to 0.04 m, crossguard 0.22 to 0.31 m, blade 0.26 to 0.90 m. To put it in a hand: parent to the hand, offset by -0.13 m along the sword's Y, then rotate so Y runs along the fist's thumb direction. Colours: blade, crossguard and pommel pale steel (moon over sky), leather-wrapped grip amber over sky. Unlike the katana it is straight, double-edged, with a wide steel crossguard and no brass.
